description: Five-panel composite of EBSD results for the non-deformed (annealed) low-density medium-Mn steel; panels are of two kinds — orientation/phase maps and grain-size histograms. (a) 3D reconstruction labelled "Phase + IQ" built from three orthogonal sections (RD-TD top, RD-ND front, TD-ND side), scale bar 100 µm; legend: white = BCC 61.2%, cyan = FCC 38.8%. Elongated white and cyan bands run along RD. (b) Magnified "Phase + IQ" map of the RD-TD plane, scale bar 5 µm, RD/TD arrows; white BCC grains labelled α (small, few-µm) alongside γ; a large δ grain occupies the left half; cyan FCC grains labelled γ. (c) 3D IPF reconstruction of the same volume with the 001-101-111 colour triangle, scale bar 100 µm, RD/TD/ND axes, showing the same banded colour mosaic. (d) γ grain-size histogram: Frequency (0.00-0.20) vs Grain Size (µm, 1-12), red hatched bars, tallest bar between the 0.16 and 0.20 gridlines near 1.5 µm, black fit curve labelled γ peaking near 1.8 µm. (e) Same axes (0-55 µm, 0.00-0.12) separating α (grey hatched bars, all below ~5 µm) and δ (red bars, ~5-55 µm, tallest between 0.10 and 0.12 at ~37 µm) with black fits. The figure demonstrates a banded α+γ ultrafine structure plus coarse δ-ferrite.

subfigures.description: 3D 'Phase + IQ' reconstruction from three normal planes (RD-TD, RD-ND, TD-ND) with RD/TD/ND arrows; banded white (BCC) and cyan (FCC) phases elongated along RD; 100 µm scale bar; legend BCC 61.2% (white), FCC 38.8% (cyan).

Magnified phase + IQ map of the RD-TD plane, 5 µm scale bar, RD/TD arrows bottom-left, legend BCC (white) / FCC (cyan). Red phase labels mark γ on cyan grains, α on small white grains, and δ on a large white grain; the BCC contrast is uniform (no martensite-like relief).

3D IPF-coloured reconstruction of the same volume with the 001-101-111 RGB colour triangle, RD/TD/ND arrows and a 100 µm scale bar; strongly banded, multi-coloured orientation mosaic with fine grains in the matrix bands.

Histogram of austenite (γ) grain size: x-axis Grain Size (µm) 0-12 (ticks to 12), y-axis Frequency 0.00-0.20; red diagonally hatched bars, tallest bar between the 0.16 and 0.20 gridlines at ≈1.5 µm, with a black fit curve labelled γ peaking near 1.8 µm; distribution truncated above ~7 µm.

Histogram separating the two ferrites: x-axis Grain Size (µm) 0-55, y-axis Frequency 0.00-0.12. Grey hatched bars labelled α are confined below ~5 µm with a sharp peak near 2 µm; red bars labelled δ span ~5-55 µm with the tallest bar between the 0.10 and 0.12 gridlines near 37 µm; black fit curves are drawn for both populations (δ curve peaks near 37 µm at ≈0.07).

observations.observation: Panel (a) legend prints BCC 61.2% (white) and FCC 38.8% (cyan) phase fractions for the non-deformed sample.
Panels (a) and (c) both carry a 100 µm scale bar and show a banded/layered structure with the bands elongated along RD; panel (b) carries a 5 µm scale bar.

Panel (b) labels individual grains with red symbols: γ on cyan (FCC) grains, α on small white (BCC) grains, and δ on a single large white grain spanning hundreds of micrometres in the field of view (approximately tens of µm at the 5 µm scale).
Panel (c) is an IPF-coloured 3D reconstruction with a 001/101/111 RGB colour key triangle, showing the same banded volume as (a) but coloured by crystallographic orientation.

In panel (d) the austenite grain-size distribution is strongly right-skewed: the modal bar lies between the 0.16 and 0.20 Frequency gridlines at a grain size near 1.5 µm, and the black γ fit curve peaks at a similar size; almost no γ grains exceed ~7 µm on this axis.

Panel (e) resolves two distinct ferrite populations: α (grey hatched bars) restricted to grain sizes below about 5 µm, and δ (red bars) spanning roughly 5-55 µm with its tallest bar between the 0.10 and 0.12 Frequency gridlines near 37 µm.
The caption states that (b) is a magnified phase + IQ local plot of the RD-TD plane of (a), and that (c) is a 3D reconstruction produced by the same method as (a).
The caption states that the grain-size distributions of (d) austenite and (e) δ/α ferrite were generated from EBSD results on the non-deformed sample.

The citing text reports average grain sizes of ~1.8 µm (austenite), ~2 µm (α-ferrite) and ~38 µm (δ-ferrite), and states the difference in size allows the two ferrites to be separated for volume-fraction calculation (25 vol. % and ..., truncated in the supplied text).

The citing text states the microstructure is a banded/layered ultrafine-grained γ+α structure reversely transformed from martensite during annealing, plus coarse δ-ferrite with grain size above ~15 µm retained from hot rolling; the band direction is along RD.

The citing text states the phase map superimposed on the image-quality map in Fig. 3(b) shows a uniform contrast of the BCC phase, signifying the absence of martensite in the non-deformed microstructure.

unreadable_items: caption panel letters are out of order as supplied ('(a) (b) (e) (d) (c)') and '(c) 3D reconstruction of IPEs' is almost certainly a typo for IPFs/IPF maps
citing sentence is truncated after '25 vol. % and', so the second ferrite volume fraction is not recoverable
individual bar heights in (d) and (e) can only be read to the nearest gridline, not to exact printed values
